approval.notes: April cathedral-close colour; the nave remains an active construction site rather than a completed later silhouette.

nodes.text: The St. Mary's Cathedral close is still a building yard. On the Domberg, masons raise the new nave beside the standing choir; lime dust lies over the path, and the unfinished pillars leave no room for a grand finished story.

choices.text: I will mark the yard, not invent a palace.

nodes.text: Then the report says what April shows: a cathedral in work, a Danish hill above, and All-linn below. The stone can wait for another season.

source_notes.summary: The cathedral's 1330s enlargement and the Spring 1343 construction-site reading are taken from the Toompea architecture dossier.
Ellen and Kalev turn the construction-site description into a concise April report while avoiding later cathedral fabric and any new character record.
